propositions: pip-audit gate fails on every patchset against main due to click 8.2.1 being vulnerable to PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection in click.edit())
inspect-ai dependency caps click below 8.2.2 via constraint click!=8.2.0,<8.2.2,>=8.1.3, making click 8.2.1 the newest resolvable version under current dependencies
click.edit() is not imported or called anywhere in rebar source code, so the vulnerable code path is unreachable despite the advisory being present in the transitive dependency tree
constraint-dependencies cannot lift the upstream cap; override-dependencies must be used to replace the inspect-ai requirement and allow click >= 8.3.3 to resolve
The cap is stale and not a real incompatibility: inspect-ai 0.3.251 imports cleanly and runs under click 8.4.2, with upstream PR pending to relax the constraint
Remediation via uv override-dependencies applies only to this repo's workspace resolution and is not published in wheel metadata, so it does not affect downstream consumers
